supersedes.note: New contract introduced by the 2026-09-19 methodology revision (audit bundle welp-vnext-audit-2026-09-19, CP-2 + CP-4 reserve standardization). Pre-revision budgets were per-task total caps over reasoning+answer with no rationale, no guaranteed answer reserve, and no portable reasoning-control story.

purpose: First-class generation-budget policy for every generation-bearing WELP phase. Makes the configuration part of the result: each task/phase freezes its answer budget, generation ceiling, reasoning mode, reasoning control (requested vs effective), and the rationale; measured budget consumption is reported per instance under welp-outcomes 0.1.0-draft.
principles: The configuration is part of the result: unreasoned caps are prohibited.
A task's answer budget is a TASK-OWNED FROZEN PROPERTY derived from the expected answer, not from the runtime or the model.

There is NO universal answer-budget multiplier law. A tokenized-reference multiplier (for example >=3x reference + formatting margin) may be used as a construction HEURISTIC when the fixture states it, but each fixture/task class must justify its budget from expected answer form, formatting requirements, acceptable semantic alternatives, a class-specific minimum floor, and expected complexity.
Reasoning mode is a declared material surface (gate_baseline_reasoning_state), frozen before execution; a post-hoc mode change is a NEW labeled configuration, never a rescue.

Only reasoning controls PROVEN effective on the pinned runtime may be load-bearing. If a requested per-request control is ignored, that is recorded as MEASURED (reasoning_requested vs reasoning_effective differ) and the requested value is never treated as effective.
Where the runtime has no enforceable reasoning/answer separation, phases run declared total-cap lanes; semantic and operational behavior is then separated by LANE, not by runtime-enforced split.

task_budget_record.answer_budget: Frozen per-task token budget sized to produce the complete expected answer including formatting margin. Justified in `rationale`. Not a semantic quantity: consuming it fully is budget evidence, not a semantic verdict.
task_budget_record.generation_ceiling: The frozen hard cap applied to the request (the total cap over all channels). Must be >= answer_budget. For single-lane tasks generation_ceiling may equal the legacy frozen cap to preserve comparability; the cap rationale then MUST be stated.
task_budget_record.reasoning_state: Declared reasoning surface for the task/phase: REASONING_ON | REASONING_OFF | CHECKPOINT_THINKING | NOT_APPLICABLE (or a narrower declared value where the profile demands).
task_budget_record.reasoning_allowance: Optional frozen reasoning-side allowance when the runtime can enforce one. Recorded requested-vs-effective. Never load-bearing unless proven effective on the pinned runtime.
task_budget_record.rationale: Per task or per task class: expected answer form, formatting requirements, acceptable semantic alternatives, class-specific minimum floor, expected complexity, and any construction heuristic used (stated as heuristic, not law).

lanes.semantic_non_starving_lane: A lane whose ceiling is sized so that a model completing normal answers is not budget-starved (answer_budget plus justified reasoning headroom). Semantic capability claims (including USEFUL_CONTEXT_MAX_SEMANTIC) may only be made from a PREDECLARED non-starving lane that actually produced a completed, scorable answer.
lanes.operational_budget_lane: The frozen operational profile lane (declared serving configuration, frozen caps). Operational behavior (completion/truncation/budget discipline) is measured here and feeds BUDGET_DISCIPLINE, never semantic labels.
lanes.application_rule: Do not automatically double every phase. Reliability-class phases and the useful-context gate MAY use the two-lane design when justified in the phase contract; single-lane phases declare which lane they are and report outcome triples regardless.

finish_accounting.rule: finish_reason is mandatory wherever the runtime exposes it (welp-outcomes 0.1.0-draft). A phase may not report COMPLETE rows with missing/unknown finish reasons when the runtime exposes them.
finish_accounting.validator: Enforced for methodology-revision-era bundles by validators/validate_campaign_welp.py (R09).

derivation.rule: reserve = max(512, 2 x answer_budget of the useful-context gate tasks).
derivation.audit_origin: 512-class rule suggested by audit bundle welp-vnext-audit-2026-09-19 section 10 and validated here against actual gate requirements.
derivation.validation: The canonical useful-context gate task answer budget is 256 tokens (fixture family A: four short factual items plus a terminal marker, measured canonical answers 40-128 completion tokens across retained campaigns). 2 x 256 = 512, so the binding value is the 512 floor. 512 covers every measured canonical gate answer with >=4x headroom while keeping occupancy >=99% achievable at every current rung.
derivation.status: MEASURED (retained campaign answer lengths 40-128 tokens) + DERIVED (multiplier rule); campaign-by-campaign 512-vs-640 variance is prohibited from this snapshot on. Exceptions require a pre-frozen, justified reserve exception recorded per the context method.

cache_policy.scientific_arms: Prompt cache DISABLED and verified uncached for scientific performance/usefulness arms, unless the phase explicitly studies cached serving (then the phase contract says so).
cache_policy.verification: Uncached state is verified, not assumed: disjoint-prompt CACHE_METRIC probe and/or cached-token telemetry where the runtime exposes it.
cache_policy.cached_measurements: Cached production behavior MAY be measured separately and MUST be labeled CACHED; it never replaces uncached canonical performance.
cache_policy.telemetry: The harness surfaces cached-token telemetry where the runtime provides it (usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens or equivalent).
cache_policy.manifest: New-era campaign manifests carry a cache_policy object (validator R13).
